📖 How to use

  1. Type your words, one per line or comma-separated.
  2. Pick a grid size and press Generate puzzle.
  3. Click-drag (or tap start, then tap end) to select a word.
  4. Find every word in the list to win.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How many words can I add?

Up to 20 words, each 3–15 letters long. Words that don't fit are listed so you can shorten them.

Which directions are words hidden in?

All 8 directions: horizontal, vertical, and diagonal — forwards and backwards.

How do I select a word on mobile?

Tap the first letter, then tap the last letter. On desktop you can also click and drag.

How do I win?

Find every word in the word list — found words get crossed off automatically.
